en: At %d% training you would reach %d.%d in about %d.%d XLs.
context: IMPORTANT: Identical printf tokens cannot be reordered. Parameter order MUST remain: training percentage, target skill integer, target skill decimal, estimated experience levels integer, estimated experience levels decimal. Chinese sentence must mention target skill BEFORE experience required. Example semantics training=100, target=10.0, experience=6.5. Do NOT reverse 10.0 and 6.5. Preserve each %d exactly and in this semantic order.
